# Francesco Colombo

> Software engineer living in the Toulouse countryside. Focused on fincrime tech, sustainability, and simple systems.

## About

- At Monzo Bank since 2016, working initially in Anti-Money Laundering (aml), financial crime, and fraud investigation (ICA qualified) before transitioning to software engineering.
- Builds internal engineering tools used by investigators when customers report fraud.
- Background in journalism and human-centric problem solving.
